methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper investigates the relationships between challenges faced by Brazilian companies in adopting Energy Management Systems (EnMS).

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper models interrelationships among EnMS adoption challenges, but does not identify or characterise an EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The study involves assembling an expert panel to assess the causal relations between key challenges identified through a literature review.

stage1.notes: Fuzzy DEMATEL ranks EnMS adoption barriers; performance indicators are mentioned only as an implementation challenge.
